description: Per-invocation usage + cost breakdown per ADR-2605282100 L1. Emitted by `kotoba_murakumo.function.Function._dispatch_*` after every live dispatch (sync, async, spawn, map, stream). Carries the same fields as the NDJSON log line + invocation linkage to the future `com.etzhayyim.murakumo.invocation` Lexicon (cross-link via `invocationCid`). Read-only audit trail; KaizenObserver downstream consumes the stream to detect Wellbecoming-vs-cost regressions per ADR-2605240200 rule R-cost-regression (R1.3e extension).

backend.description: Resolved backend identifier (matches the tariff row backend).

endpointUrl.description: Resolved endpoint URL (LAN-only per fleet.toml; never a commercial GPU rental URL per ADR-2605215000).

tariffVersion.description: Tariff version in force at dispatch time (joins to com.etzhayyim.kotoba.economy.tariff).

costMkoto.description: Actual mKOTO debited from caller balance for this invocation.

costEstimatedMkoto.description: Pre-flight estimate carried for over/under reconciliation.

charterIn.description: Charter Rider §2 scan severity on input (per ADR-2605192200 + ADR-2605282000 §'Charter Rider §2 scan hook').

invocationCid.description: CID linking to the future com.etzhayyim.murakumo.invocation record (R1.3e cross-link).

gpuMilliseconds.description: GPU-time consumed by this invocation, in integer milliseconds. Equal to latencyMs for HTTP-routed LLM dispatch (whole call is on-GPU); diverges from latencyMs for kotoba-vm WASM Component dispatch (where part of the elapsed time is host-side BSP scheduling). Religious-corp Lexicon convention: no float types — implied unit is documented per ADR-2605190900.

coldStart.description: Modal-parity: true iff this invocation triggered a cold-start surcharge (R2 wiring).
